scientific_integrity: All nonstandard finite upper bounds have executable, embedded complete exact certificates; an elementary proof covers the infinite tail. Prior literature supplied the general multiset metric and intersection reduction; its claims are not represented as new.
scientific_limitations: Classification is for the four-symbol alphabet and exactly three retained symbols only.
The finite upper bounds for source sizes 4 to 8 rely on a fully exhaustive, reproducible finite combinatorial search.
The result does not classify all extremal codes up to alphabet permutation.
Historical priority may be affected by an unindexed earlier exact table; independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
title: Exact four-symbol multiset deletion codes with three survivors
